description: Source code for managing image slot states in Zephyr-based firmware, including functions for reading, setting, and confirming image slot states, as well as handling boot slot transitions and encoding slot information for management protocols.

methods.name: img_mgmt_state_flags
methods.description: Returns flags indicating the state of a specified image slot, considering swap type and active image status, with different logic depending on configuration.

methods.name: img_mgmt_get_next_boot_slot
methods.description: Determines the next boot slot for an image, considering swap state, including special handling for direct XIP mode and revert scenarios.

methods.name: img_mgmt_state_any_pending
methods.description: Checks if any image slot is pending (scheduled for swap on next reboot).

methods.name: img_mgmt_slot_in_use
methods.description: Checks if a specific slot is in use or can be erased, considering pending swaps and active slots.

methods.name: img_mgmt_state_set_pending
methods.description: Sets a slot as pending for boot swap, with optional permanence.

methods.name: img_mgmt_state_confirm
methods.description: Confirms the current image state, preventing fallback on reboot.

methods.name: img_mgmt_state_encode_slot
methods.description: Encodes slot information into zcbor format, including version, hash, and flags.

methods.name: img_mgmt_state_read
methods.description: Reads and encodes the current state of images and slots into a management protocol response.

methods.name: img_mgmt_set_next_boot_slot_common
methods.description: Common logic to set the next boot slot, updating bootloader state and notifying callbacks.

methods.name: img_mgmt_set_next_boot_slot
methods.description: Sets the next boot slot, with logic to prevent invalid configurations, considering configuration options.

methods.name: img_mgmt_state_write
methods.description: Handles writing new image slot states based on management protocol commands, including hash and confirmation.
